items.source: Configures an MCP sync client specification by applying all registered customizers.
items.translation: 通过应用所有已注册的自定义器来配置 MCP 同步客户端规范。

items.source: This class manages a collection of McpClientCustomizer<io.modelcontextprotocol.client.McpClient.SyncSpec> instances that can be applied to customize the configuration of MCP synchronous clients during their creation.
items.translation: 该类管理一组 McpClientCustomizer<io.modelcontextprotocol.client.McpClient.SyncSpec> 实例，这些实例可用于在创建 MCP 同步客户端时定制其配置。

items.source:
The configurer applies customizations in the order they are registered, allowing for
sequential modifications to the client specifications.
items.translation: 配置器按照注册顺序应用自定义设置，从而实现对客户端规格的顺序修改。

items.source: name - the name of the client being configured
items.translation: name - 正在配置的客户端名称

items.source: Configurer class for customizing MCP synchronous clients.
items.translation: 用于自定义 MCP 同步客户端的 Configurer 类。
